mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_num, c.post_num, c.user_num, u.user_nick AS user_name, c.comment_content, c.comment_date AS post_commented_date FROM t_comment c INNER JOIN t_user u ON c.user_num = u.user_num WHERE c.post_num = #{postNum} ORDER BY c.comment_num DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
